terms.gloss: an enclosure where game or fish are kept alive; a park, warren, preserve
evidence: Plin. NH 8.52.78.211; Sen. Clem. 1.18.2 (Lewis & Short s.v. vīvārius)
terms.comment: The same word serves for a zoo.
Not in Lewis & Short; Greek in form (“beast-rearing place”). The quantities are left unmarked where Greek gives no guide.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
